# 00000006229

**GT5-09 ★** — source: 193_几何范畴论.md

**English.** Definition: Compact generation is the structure where the category is generated by compact objects. Conjecture: The conversion constant is explicit in the codensity of compact objects and the compactness of constant sheaves is given by minimal covers; the coefficient of the minimal cover is one; and the spectrum of compact objects splits under localization, the index of the split being the cover count. (minimal-cover codensity conversion of compact objects)

**中文。** 定义：紧生成：范畴由紧对象生成的结构。猜想：换算常数为紧对象的余密显式且常值层的紧性由极小覆盖给出；极小覆盖的系数为一；紧对象的谱在局部化下分裂且分裂的指标为覆盖数。（紧对象余密极小覆盖换算）
